title: Active MRR by plan, as of 2025-06-30
prompt: What's the monthly recurring revenue (MRR) by plan, counting only subscriptions active as of 2025-06-30?
population: Subscriptions active on 2025-06-30 (started on or before that date, not yet ended), joined to plans.
metricDefinition: sum(monthly_price) from subscriptions active as of 2025-06-30, grouped by plan.
referenceSql: SELECT p.name, sum(p.monthly_price) AS mrr FROM subscriptions s JOIN plans p ON p.plan_id = s.plan_id WHERE s.started_at <= TIMESTAMP '2025-06-30' AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-30') GROUP BY p.name

commonWrongAnswers.sql: SELECT p.name, sum(p.monthly_price) AS mrr FROM subscriptions s JOIN plans p ON p.plan_id = s.plan_id WHERE s.status = 'active' GROUP BY p.name
commonWrongAnswers.whyWrong: Uses the subscription's current status instead of whether it was active on the specific date being asked about — this answers 'MRR right now', not 'MRR as of 2025-06-30'.
